title: Add test: queryChanges with TooManyChanges{limit:0} returns cannotCalculateChanges
description: Add integration test covering PLAN.md line 440. MemoryBackend needs a way to force query_changes to return BackendChangesError::TooManyChanges { limit: 0 } for a specific type. Assert the handler returns JmapError with type=cannotCalculateChanges.
